description: Reads one public X (Twitter) profile by username and returns id, name, handle, url, description, location, followers_count, following_count, posts_count and verified. It does not return posts, replies, follower lists or search results; for posts, google_search can find indexed pages. Required: username.

username.description: Public X username, letters, digits and underscores, with or without the leading @, e.g. "nasa" or "@nasa". Not a profile URL.

name: x_profile
title: X Profile
